name: chat-screen
description: A generic phone chat printed out and lying on the field (paper card, seeded tilt, soft shadow; no app colours or logos). 3–5 messages type in one by one, stagger s apart (first 0.3 s after the cut): 'them' messages after a typing-dots bubble, 'me' messages slide in from the right in a soft haldi tint. Layout is reserved from the cut — nothing reflows. messages: [{from: 'me'|'them', text, time?}] (text takes *marker*; max 6). name (optional) adds a header with a back chevron + initial avatar; pinned (optional) adds a pinned-message bar at the top. highlight (message index, default -1) gets a blue-ballpoint circle drawn 0.3 s after it lands. Timestamps are JetBrains Mono (printout metadata) on a seeded clock; set msg.time to fix one, times:false hides them. width px (560–880, default 820); tilt (deg) fixes the tilt instead of the seeded one. grow:true sizes the paper to the messages already shown (rows take no space until they arrive) instead of reserving the final height. minHeight px (default 0) keeps the paper at least that tall so a two-message card fills the zone. Keep it to ~5 one-line messages so it stays inside the content zone.
